cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader, is old and well along in years. I feel that, friend: by my last years in the Millers' kitchen, my cookies came out looking like thumbprints. Then the LORD speaks to Joshua.

cards.question: The LORD tells old Joshua something about the land. What does He say?

answers.text: Very much of the land remains to be possessed
All of the land has now been possessed
The land must wait for a new leader

cards.text: Then the LORD lists what's left: the land of the Philistines and their five rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron, plus Canaanite land, the Gebalites and all Lebanon up to Lebo-hamath. That's not a to-do list. That's a to-do SCROLL.

cards.question: The LORD says the people of the hill country, all the Sidonians, will be driven out before Israel. Who does He say will do it?

answers.text: The tribes east of the Jordan

cards.question: The LORD tells Joshua to divide the land by ___ as an inheritance to Israel.
The LORD tells Joshua to divide this land as an inheritance. Who is it for?

answers.text: Nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh
The tribes of Reuben and Gad

cards.text: Why not everybody? Because Reuben, Gad and the other half of Manasseh already have their land, across the Jordan to the east. They got the keys before anybody else even saw the house.

cards.question: Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh received their land east of the Jordan from ___, the servant of the LORD.

cards.text: That eastern land runs from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley up through Gilead, the land of the Geshurites and Maacathites, Mount Hermon and all Bashan. It's the old kingdoms of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og of Bashan, a remnant of the Rephaim, and Moses had struck those kings down and taken their land.

cards.question: Sihon and Og are gone, but the Geshurites and Maacathites get a line all their own. True or false: the Israelites drove the Geshurites and the Maacathites out of the eastern land.
Moses gave the tribe of Levi no inheritance. What is Levi's inheritance instead?

answers.text: The food offerings to the LORD

cards.text: Reuben's clans get the plateau from Aroer to Heshbon, Sihon's old kingdom, with the bank of the Jordan as their border. Tucked in the list: Moses killed Sihon and the chiefs of Midian, and the Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor.
Gad's clans get Jazer, all the cities of Gilead and half the land of the Ammonites, plus valley towns like Succoth, right up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth.

The half-tribe of Manasseh, the clans of Machir son of Manasseh, gets half of Gilead and all of Og's kingdom in Bashan, including the towns of Jair: sixty cities. SIXTY. I've got one bakery and I STILL can't find my timer.
Those are the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.

cards.question: True or false: the passage ends by saying the LORD, the God of Israel, is the inheritance of the tribe of Levi.

findings.problem: This story card is not the opening card but has three sentences. It also walks the land item by item, naming all five Philistine cities plus the Gebalites, Lebanon and Lebo-hamath, when it should sum up the stretch in a few words.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This is a summary card for a stretch of land boundaries (Joshua 13:2-5), but it lists the territories one by one instead of saying briefly what the stretch covers.

rule.text: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: "Why not everybody?", the explanation, and the joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the allotment, "SIXTY." and the timer joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card says the half-tribe's land went to "the clans of Machir son of Manasseh," which suggests all of Machir's clans. Joshua 13:31 says it was for "half of the descendants of Machir."

rule.text: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

findings.problem: The eastern tribal allotments (Joshua 13:15-32) are one continuous stretch of land boundaries and town lists with no moments in between. They are told across four story cards (12, 13, 14, 15), one per tribe plus a wrap-up, instead of being summed up in one card.

rule.text: Papa Dorin sums up the stretch in one story card.
